title: A Boy in Greece
text: Long ago, in Greece, there was a boy named Theseus. He lived with his mom, Aethra.

title: The Big Rock
text: One day, his mom took him to a big rock. His dad had left a gift under it.

title: One More Try
text: Theseus pushed the rock. He pushed again, and at last the rock moved!

title: A Gift from His Father
text: Under the rock were a sword and a pair of shoes. They had belonged to his dad, King Aegeus of Athens.

title: Ready to Go
text: Aethra told Theseus he was ready to meet his dad. Theseus wanted to make his mom proud.

title: The Long Road
text: Theseus could take a boat to Athens. But he chose the long road, even though it was not safe.

title: Courage on the Road
text: Bad men hurt people on the road. Theseus was scared, but he fought them and stopped them.

title: A Safer Journey
text: Theseus helped keep the road safe. At last, he came to Athens.

title: Home at Last
text: King Aegeus saw the sword and shoes and knew his son. They gave each other a big hug.

title: The Sad Children
text: Theseus saw a group of sad kids. They had to go to Crete, where the Minotaur lived in a huge maze.

title: A Brave Choice
text: The young people sent to the maze did not come home. Theseus felt scared, but he chose to go and help.

title: Ariadne’s Gift
text: Princess Ariadne was kind and smart. She gave Theseus a ball of red thread to help him find his way out.

title: Into the Maze
text: Theseus let the thread fall as he walked. The dark path went left, then right, then left again.

title: The Minotaur
text: Suddenly, the Minotaur was there! Theseus took out his sword and stood tall, even though his hands shook.

title: The Way Out
text: Theseus won the fight and followed the thread back. He led the kids out of the maze, and they were free.

title: Sailing Away
text: Theseus and Ariadne sailed away together. They came to an island called Naxos.

title: A Friend Left Behind
text: Theseus left Ariadne on the island. She had helped save his life, but now she was alone.

title: The Forgotten Sail
text: Theseus had promised to put up a white sail if he came home safe. But he forgot, and the ship still had its black sail.

title: A Father’s Grief
text: King Aegeus saw the black sail and thought his son was dead. In his grief, he jumped into the sea and never came back.

title: A Promise Lost
text: When Theseus got home, he heard the news and cried. He had won a big fight, but he had lost his dad.

title: One Big Team
text: Theseus became king and helped bring the towns near Athens together. People could do more when they worked as a team.

title: A Very Bad Plan
text: Theseus and Pirithous tried to take Persephone away without asking her. Hades caught them in the land of the dead, and they were stuck.

title: Help from Heracles
text: Later, Heracles came and saved Theseus. Being brave had not made his bad plan right.

title: The Lie
text: Phaedra told a terrible lie about Hippolytus. Theseus became angry and did not stop to hear his son’s side.

title: Too Late to Listen
text: Theseus asked Poseidon to punish his son, and Hippolytus died. Later, Theseus learned that his son had done nothing wrong.

title: The Last Journey
text: As an old man, Theseus left Athens and went to Skyros. There, King Lycomedes pushed him off a cliff, and Theseus died.

title: What Makes a Hero?
text: Many years later, people brought his bones to Athens and honored him. His story reminds us that a real hero is kind, fair, and true.
